questions.text: What is the safest way to frame Philippine housing finance from the checked sources?

options.text: As a split system of shelter production, mortgage-market support, provident or member finance, socialized housing, and community mortgage mechanisms
As one universal loan program for all households
As a building-permit process only
As a private bank product with no public shelter role

questions.rationale: EO 90, RA 11201 IRR, RA 7279, RA 7160, and IRR RA 7279 Sec 18 divide housing finance and production roles across several mechanisms.
questions.explanation: SSS serves private sector, not informal. GSIS serves government, not informal. SSS is the Social Security System for private sector workers. GSIS (Government Service Insurance System) serves government employees. Both offer housing loans but to distinct beneficiary groups. SSS is not universal employment; both have specific eligible groups. Both SSS and GSIS are mandatory for their respective member classes. This question cannot be verified against the provided search results, which contain no information about SSS or GSIS housing programs. Recommend adding authoritative sources (SSS Charter, GSIS Charter) to the search results before using this question. Both offer housing loans but to distinct beneficiary groups. SSS = private sector workers; GSIS = government employees. Membership defines eligibility.
